subject: Q2 forecast pulse — stage ownership, handoff, and submission runbook
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.example.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 forecast pulse — stage ownership, handoff, and submission runbook

Team —

Quick one to align before the pulse call on Thursday (Apr 3, 9:00 AM PT). We need everyone to finalize their deal-level inputs so Finance has a clean submission by EOD Thursday. Do not treat this as a generic reminder — there are three specific things I need from each owner before the call: 

1) Stage ownership: confirm owner on any deal currently in Negotiation / Contracting. If you're not the owner, add the owner in the SF_Handoff field and tag them in the deal comment.
2) Commit flag justification: for any deal you mark as COMMIT set a one-line reason (what changed) and the primary risk mitigator.
3) Close date sanity check: if close date moved more than two weeks from last update, add a short note and new predicted close probability.

Attached is the forecast_submission_template_v3.xlsx — please populate ACV, close probability, and the short justification column. I'll run a quick pre-call triage Wednesday afternoon and surface any obvious mismatches.

Call details / agenda (30m):
- 9:00 — 9:05: quick lock criteria & rules of the road
- 9:05 — 9:15: 3 randomized deal spot-checks (Karthik and Marissa to lead)
- 9:15 — 9:25: at-risk table & escalation list (Marcus to own)
- 9:25 — 9:30: final submission window + handoff to Finance

Please confirm you received this and your ETA for the template (I need the filled sheet by 5:00 PM PT on Apr 3). If you have a large deal that needs exec review, flag it in the template and put "ESCALATE" in column H.

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: 415-555-0123

Attachments: forecast_submission_template_v3.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>

Subject: Re: Q2 forecast pulse — stage ownership, handoff, and submission runbook

Got it — thanks for the clarity, Aisha. I'll take point on the randomized spot-checks. Quick Q on ACME (ACME-2028-371): they pushed procurement review into next week and want a formal SOW and pricing sheet before signature. Do we treat that as COMMIT with a higher risk?

My plan: mark ACME as "Commit (conditional)" with a short justification and set the mitigator to "SOW in flight + procurement demo scheduled." If that sounds right I will also add a calendar note for exec review if the SOW is ready before Friday.
